props.name: topic
props.comment: Defaults to the topic of the ambient resource and record.

props.name: currentUser
props.comment: Defaults to the auth provider's identity.

props.name: maxAvatars
props.comment: How many avatars show before the rest collapse into `+N`. Default 5.

props.name: heartbeatMs
props.comment: How often the announce is republished. Default 15000.

props.name: staleMs
props.comment: A user unheard for longer than this is dropped. Default 30000.
